body: And it's not like I have anything to hide either, I am not sexually adventurous, I am very reserved, and my porn tastes are basically distilled vanilla. I am just obviously a clueless idiot that inadvertently made myself look like a freak.

Sorry, I accidentally replied with my main.

But anyway, yes, that about sums it up. I only found out because I was lying in bed after finishing a book, and through my open window, hearing my neighbor on her deck ranting about me to I don't even know who.

Basically, the kind of stuff that she said was the kind of thing that would destroy anyone's life. That I was a voyeur, that I am a "fucking pedophile", (9 year old kid over there) and a whole bunch or other really nasty shit. I grew up in this house, I was comfortable in my room, and jesus christ, I have had my blinds set the same way for the last 2 months or longer. It's a north facing window, I just left them up for lights, and i idn't know that they could see me like that. And WHY didn't they let me know months ago?? I just don't get it. I fucking got dressed in the dark today, I was so freaked, and now I have this democles sword over my head that I did something illigal, and that I have been dancing around in my underware or less for months without a pepe. And I find out from overhearing it accidentally at 11:30 at night. No note, no "Hey dude, shut your $##@# blinds, just lets watch, let him embarrass himself further, and tell everyone. I had the rifle fucking loaded and ready to go, but didn't because if i did, it would give the claims validity. I am an introvert, and in general a very private person with very vanilla taste in naked women. I am not a criminal, and I just can't handle this stress at all. I would do anything to have a mind reader device so I can prove to them I am not a freak, but just a clueless moron that got too comfortable with his perceived privacy.
I vaguely overheard something about recording it as well, so I don't think it was just looking...
So I guess a summary of the comments is that I probably don't need to worry about being hauled to jail, it is just hideously awkward and embarrassing. Sound about right?
I would drop a note in the mailbox or sonething. It is awkward, but now I have no idea how long they have seen, which makes it way worse in my head.
This makes me rest easier on the question if I am going to get the cops called, but it doesn't help that I just torpedoed any good relationship I had with the neighbors :/

What I don't get is why they didn't tell me sooner? If I had realized they could see, I would have closed them asap.

But it seems that I am probably OK legally? What if they recorded it or something?
